title: Anker Play Products Recalls Bolt Foldable Children's Scooters Due to Violation of Federal Lead Paint Ban; Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The paint on the recalled scooters contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban, posing a lead poisoning hazard. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 5,000.

summary: Surface paint on the miniature skateboard and scooter toys in the ramp sets contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban, posing a risk of lead poisoning. title: Clarks Americas Recalls Women's Navy Blue Canvas Shoes Due to Chemical Hazard
summary: Prolonged and direct contact with the shoes' upper material can expose the wearer to the chemicals benzidine and/or dimethoxybenzidine, which are toxic and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 113,000 (In addition, about 10,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Empower Brands Recalls Black+Decker® Garment Steamers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The steamers can expel, spray or leak hot water during use, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 518,500.

title: FHS Retail Recalls FUUL Lamp Oil Products Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Packaging Requirement and Violation of FHSA Labeling Requirement; Poisoning Risk to Children
summary: The product contains low-viscosity petroleum distillates which must be in child-resistant packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). title: Myx Recalls MYX I, MYX II and MYX II Plus Exercise Bicycles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The pedals can loosen and/or detach when not properly tightened at installation, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 162,000.

title: Power Plus Recalls Tora Portable Power Charging Stations Due to Fire and Explosion Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery in the recalled portable power charging stations can catch on fire while charging, posing fire and explosion hazards. Units: About 115.

title: Rad Power Bikes Recalls RadWagon 4 Electric Cargo Bikes Due to Fall and Crash Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The rim strip on the tires can be misaligned, causing the tube to pop and damage the tire. Additionally, the tires with a ribbed sidewall can unexpectedly go flat, risking serious injuries from loss of control and/or crash. Units: About 29,300.

title: Reckitt Recalls AirWick Fresh Linen and Fresh Water Aerosol Air Fresheners Due to Injury and Laceration Hazards
summary: A single batch of the aerosol air fresheners is missing a corrosion inhibitor, which can lead to corrosion and rupture of the metal can and expulsion of the contents, posing injury and laceration hazards. title: Children's Rainbow Stacking Toys Recalled Due to Choking Hazard; Manufactured by Professor Puzzle
summary: The toy's information sticker can become exposed and detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,350 (In addition, about 600 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Industries Recalls MATRYX, AXYS and Pro-Ride Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Electrostatic discharge inside the fuel tank can cause vapors to ignite during operation and the tank to burst, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 138,000 (In addition, about 61,000 were sold in Canada).

title: The William Carter Company Recalls Infant's Yellow Footed Fleece Pajamas with Animal Graphic Due to Puncture and Laceration Hazards
summary: Small metal wire pieces can be found in the pajamas, posing puncture and laceration hazards to young children. Units: About 50,800 (In addition, about 200 were sold in Canada).

title: CPSC Reannounces Recall of Generac Portable Generators; Additional Finger Amputation and Crushing Injury Reported; New Repair Kit Available
summary: An unlocked handle can pinch consumers' fingers against the generator frame when the generator is moved, posing finger amputation and crushing hazards. Units: About 321,160 (In addition, 4,575 were sold in Canada) These portable generators were previously recalled in July 2021.

title: Hunter Fan Recalls Lighting Products Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The internal wires in the lights can be damaged, posing an electric shock hazard to the consumer. Units: About 2,600.

title: Mockingbird Recalls Single-to-Double Strollers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The lower side of the stroller frame can crack, posing a fall risk to children in the stroller. Units: About 149,000.

title: Bentex Recalls Children's Clothing Sets Due to Violation of the Federal Lead Paint and Lead Content Ban; Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The textile ink painted on the recalled clothing sets contains levels of lead that exceed either the federal lead paint ban or the federal lead content ban, posing a lead poisoning hazard. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 87,000.

title: Green Sprouts Recalls Toddler's Stainless Steel Bottles and Cups Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled stainless-steel bottles and cups bottom base can break off, exposing a solder dot that contains lead, posing a lead poisoning hazard to the child. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children, and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 10,500.

title: Indigo Books & Music Recalls Indigo Branded Bear Mugs Due to Burn and Laceration Hazards
summary: The recalled mugs can crack or break when filled with hot liquid, posing burn and laceration hazards. Units: About 270 (In addition, about 29,232 were sold in Canada).
